name: Milestone Global Ltd
about: Incorporated in 1991, Milestone Global Ltd manufactures and sells Polished Granite Monuments.[1]
keyPoints:
Business Overview:[1]
MGL is an export-oriented company which is engaged in the manufacturing and trading of Monuments and Monuments related products.

cons: Though the company is reporting repeated profits, it is not paying out dividend
The company has delivered a poor sales growth of -0.21% over past five years.
Company has a low return on equity of 5.74% over last 3 years.
